title: 정정보도청구 등 사건 심판규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Applications)
(1) An application for a corrective report, etc. under Article 26 of the Act shall state the following matters:
1. The purport of the application, including the corrective report, reply report, or subsequent report sought to be published or broadcast, and the desired size, timing, frequency, placement, or broadcasting order of the report; and, where an application is made under Article 261 of the Civil Execution Act, the purport thereof;
2. The grounds for the application, including the reasons for seeking the corrective report, reply report, or subsequent report, or an application under Article 261 of the Civil Execution Act.
(2) The application under paragraph (1) shall be accompanied by the text of the article or the contents of the report at issue and, where the matter has undergone mediation or arbitration by the Press Arbitration Commission, documents establishing that fact.
